settings.heading: Which healthcare and community settings do you support?
settings.text: Programs can be designed for hospitals, aged care, disability services, community health, home-care, mobile teams and related contractors. The final scope should reflect each organisation’s roles, locations and governance requirements.

settings.heading: Can testing accommodate prescribed medication?
settings.text: Yes. The program should include a confidential declaration and review pathway so prescribed medication can be considered appropriately without treating a screening result as a final determination.

settings.heading: How do you protect privacy and consent?
settings.text: Privacy controls, informed consent, restricted access, secure records and clear communication responsibilities should be defined before rollout and aligned with applicable workplace and organisational requirements.

settings.heading: Can you support mobile and multi-site care teams?
settings.text: Yes. Equipment, procedures, training, calibration and reporting can be standardised across fixed facilities and mobile services while allowing for local operating needs.
